dedupe_keys.name: bruit dans l environnement cartographie du bruit 2022

description: The Rhône departmental authority lists 2022 environmental noise cartography for transport infrastructure. Its description states that noise levels emitted by a given infrastructure during an average day are evaluated using numerical models. Those models produce equal-noise contours that are translated into zones using the full-day Lden and night-time Ln indicators. Strategic maps describe exposure, affected sectors, exceedances of limit values and known or expected changes in noise levels. The supported role is the assessment of exposure to modelled transport infrastructure noise. The source presents the maps as information for planning and traffic management and does not establish that they replace a detailed local acoustic study. The native spatial metadata provides a bounding polygon, and the listed distributions include Shapefile packages and public WMS or WFS descriptions, alongside intranet variants. An Open Licence is stated. The 2022 identity is retained separately from other editions. Map layers, transport-specific coverage and file contents have not been inspected.
